text:
# Built only from what automatic markup found in "The Thunderer" (no hand-picked regions):
# its best drum loop and horn loop, and a band one-shot, through a 12-bar blues in F.

tempo 100
key F mixolydian
samples ../samples

clip groove = marine-band/stems/Thunderer/drums.wav  loop-1   warp beats
clip riff   = marine-band/stems/Thunderer/other.wav  loop-1
clip hit    = marine-band/Thunderer.mp3  shot-3

chords I7 IV7 I7 . | IV7 . I7 . | V7 IV7 I7 V7

track groove  transpose 0
track riff    follow  volume -2
track hit     follow  at 1 5 9 11  volume -4
title: markup-demo
